about_short_description.short_description: LifeAt is a productivity platform with focus tools like timers, music, notes, and virtual workspace backgrounds.

product.name: LifeAt Virtual Co-Working Rooms
product.description: Online shared workspaces where users can join themed rooms to work, study, or collaborate with others remotely.

product.name: LifeAt AI Creators
product.description: AI-generated interactive characters that users can chat with for advice, motivation, tutoring, or casual conversation.

product.name: LifeAt Business Management Tools
product.description: A suite of tools for business users including project management, task tracking, calendar integration, invoicing, and time tracking.

product.name: LifeAt Desktop Application
product.description: A desktop app for macOS and Windows that provides quick access to LifeAt features and calendar integration from the user’s device.

product.name: LifeAt Creator Platform
product.description: A platform for content creators to upload and share productivity-related videos and build communities within LifeAt.
